```{r load libraries, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(infer)
library(broom)
library(rstan)
library(rstantools)
library(cowplot)
rstan_options(auto_write = TRUE)
```

```{r}
diabetes_data <- read_csv("../../data/cooked/clean_data.csv")
diabetes_data
```

```{r}
problem_cols <- diabetes_data %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), n_distinct)) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(),
               names_to  = "column",
               values_to = "n_unique") %>%
  filter(n_unique < 2)

print(problem_cols)  # these are your offending columns
```

```{r}
diabetes_data_clean <- diabetes_data %>%
  select(where(~ n_distinct(.) > 1))
```

```{r}
problem_cols <- diabetes_data_clean %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), n_distinct)) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(),
               names_to  = "column",
               values_to = "n_unique") %>%
  filter(n_unique < 2)

print(problem_cols)
```

```{r}
small_clean <- diabetes_data_clean |> slice(1:100)
small_clean
```

```{r}
problem_cols <- small_clean %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), n_distinct)) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(),
               names_to  = "column",
               values_to = "n_unique") %>%
  filter(n_unique < 2)

small_clean_clean <- small_clean %>%
  select(where(~ n_distinct(.) > 1))

print(small_clean_clean) 
```

```{r}
glm_all <- glm(as.factor(readmitted) ~ ., family = binomial, data = small_clean_clean)
tidy(glm_all) |> filter(p.value < 0.9)
```
